hubbard_finite_shots.method: Independent Born multinomial draws after local Pauli basis rotations; exact-expectation VQE training
hubbard_finite_shots.interval_method: Two-sided Hoeffding across independent weighted shots, retaining within-group covariance; marginal 95% CIs for prepared-state expectations. Older group union-bound intervals are retained as a diagnostic baseline.
hubbard_finite_shots.contrast_method: Preselected D(U/t=6) minus D(U/t=8), using independent preparations at both interactions and a direct two-sided 95% Hoeffding bound. Positive lower bound resolves a decrease; no simultaneous scan coverage is claimed.

cost.assumptions: Equal shots within each strategy; five grouped settings at n shots versus ten independent Pauli terms at n/2 shots, matching total preparations. All observables share those counts. Identity costs no shots. Shot totals exclude exact training evaluations, state-preparation circuit costs, basis-switching overhead and gate compilation. Neither allocation is optimized.

method.evaluation: Portfolio: exact distribution expectations. Hubbard: finite-shot Pauli evaluation after exact-expectation training.
method.gap: Conditional feasible objective minus exact feasible minimum (additive)
method.qaoa_selection: Minimum expected penalized objective on the fixed 17 by 17 grid

cost_assumptions.rejection_cost: 1 / feasible_probability independent draws per accepted portfolio
cost_assumptions.feasible_sampler: Uniform over fixed-cardinality subsets; no rejected draws
cost_assumptions.excluded_costs: No timing, hardware, monetary, or end-to-end speed comparison; enumeration shared

provenance.data: Synthetic PSD covariance and expected returns; defined two-site Hubbard Hamiltonian with t=1

limitations: Exponential CPU statevector and a coarse p=1 grid; no quantum speedup claim.
Feasibility is measured before postselection; conditional objective excludes rejected samples.
Binary unit holdings, not continuous normalized portfolio weights.
Portfolio: one synthetic instance; exact distribution metrics are not finite-shot observations.
Uniform feasible distribution uses the enumerated mask here; general constraints may be harder to sample.
Portfolio training uses exact penalized expectations; rejection cost excludes training and sampler setup.
Hubbard: ideal Born shots after exact training; marginal CIs cover prepared-state expectations, not ansatz bias or model error. No hardware noise or materials predictions.
